name: How Do You Compare Kitchen Remodel Bids?

mainEntity.name: How do I compare bids for a kitchen remodel without choosing the wrong one?
mainEntity.text: How do I compare bids for a kitchen remodel without choosing the wrong one?

acceptedAnswer.text: To compare kitchen remodel bids correctly, put each proposal side by side and look for differences in scope, not just totals. Check whether each bid includes demolition, permits, cabinets, countertops, flooring, lighting, plumbing, electrical, cleanup, and inspections. Review allowances carefully, because one contractor may budget much less for finishes than another. That can make a bid look cheaper when it is really just less complete. In Los Angeles County, also ask whether the contractor understands local permit steps and whether site conditions or code upgrades have been considered. A complete bid that explains assumptions is usually more reliable than a low number with missing details. The goal is to compare what each contractor is actually promising to deliver.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compare bids by scope, materials, allowances, permits, exclusions, and timeline, not just price. The lowest bid can be incomplete if it leaves out labor, code upgrades, or finish selections that will be added later through change orders.
